welcome.title: Welcome to Mossbook
welcome.body: A place for your notes: how you feel, what happened, fears and sleep. Everything stays on this device, encrypted. No account, no server, nothing is sent anywhere.
welcome.disclaimer: Mossbook is not a substitute for professional help. If you are in danger, call 112.

password.title: Set a password
password.body: The password opens your journal. Pick one you don't use anywhere else. A few ordinary words are easiest to remember.

phrase.title: Your recovery key
phrase.body: These 24 words open the journal if you forget your password. Write them on paper and keep it somewhere safe.
phrase.warning: If you lose both your password and this key, nobody (not even us) can recover your entries.
phrase.saved: I have stored the key somewhere safe

confirm.title: Let's check the key
confirm.body: Type the words at these positions, copying them from your paper.

lock.title: Your journal is locked
lock.subtitle: Enter your password to open the journal.

recover.title: Recover access
recover.body: Enter the 24 words of your recovery key and set a new password. The key stays the same.

timeline.title: Your journal
timeline.unreadable: Some saved data could not be read ({count}). Your other entries are safe.
timeline.emptyHint: Tap + to note how you are. It takes a few seconds.

entry.deleteConfirm: Delete this entry? This cannot be undone.

quick.title: Quick entry
quick.chooseKind: What do you want to note?
quick.done: Saved. You can complete it later.

tags.title: Tags
tags.name: Name
tags.deleteConfirm: Delete this tag? It will be removed from all entries.
tags.mergeConfirm: Merge? Entries with this tag will get the chosen tag.
tags.duplicate: A tag with this name already exists.

help.open: Plan for a hard moment / phones
help.title: When it's hard
help.intro: You don't have to cope alone. You can call someone or do a short exercise.
help.noCountry: We don't have numbers for your country yet. In the European Union, call 112 in an emergency.
help.callFailed: Could not start the call. Dial it yourself: {number}

exercise.done: Well done. Stay for a moment with how you feel now.
exercise.intro478: Breathe in through your nose for 4 seconds, hold for 7, breathe out slowly through your mouth for 8. Four times.
exercise.introBox: Breathe in, hold, breathe out, hold: 4 seconds each. Four times.
exercise.introGrounding: Look around and name what you notice, one step at a time. Take your time.

plan.title: Plan for a hard moment
plan.intro: Prepare it at a calmer time. It will be at hand when things get hard.
plan.self_coping: What I can do on my own
plan.calming_people_places: People and places that calm me
plan.safe_environment: How to keep my surroundings safe
plan.name: Name

settings.title: Settings
settings.immediately: As soon as you leave the app

backup.title: Backup
backup.intro: A backup is a single encrypted file. It opens with the password or recovery key from the day it was made.
backup.sameVault: This is a backup of this same journal.
backup.mode: What to do with your current entries
backup.merge: Merge: add what is missing, keep newer versions
backup.replace: Replace: the journal becomes exactly the backup
backup.replaceWarning: Entries that are not in the backup will be deleted.
backup.restoreIntro: Have a .mossbook file from another device? Choose it and open it with its password or recovery key. The journal keeps the backup's password and key.

password.title: Change password
password.changed: Password changed. Your recovery key stays the same.
password.oldBackups: Older backups still open with the previous password.

destroy.title: Delete all data
destroy.intro: Your journal, tags, plan and settings will be permanently deleted from this device. Backups saved elsewhere stay.
destroy.question: Delete all data for good? This cannot be undone.
